load_extensions_config: load extensions config from a JSON file with automatic path resolution and environment variable substitution
resolve_extensions_config_path: resolve the path to an extensions config file using argument, environment variable, or default search locations
get_enabled_mcp_servers: get a dictionary of only the enabled MCP servers from the extensions config
check_skill_enabled: check whether a named skill in a given category is enabled in the extensions config
reload_extensions_config: reload the extensions config from file and update the cached singleton instance
